name: pdf
title: pdf
description: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.

related_skills.name: academic-pdf-redaction
related_skills.reason: Academic PDF redaction is a narrower PDF-processing capability within a broader PDF manipulation toolkit.

related_skills.name: marker
related_skills.reason: Marker only converts PDFs to Markdown with formula/structure preservation; pdf covers broader PDF extraction, creation, editing, forms, and document operations.

related_skills.name: pdf-reading
related_skills.reason: pdf-reading covers extraction only; pdf also creates, merges, splits, fills forms, and broader PDF processing.
